summary: Each turn's work log uses one Thinking disclosure for all its reasoning entries, including thoughts separated by tool calls. Source order and individual Markdown bodies remain intact; bounded backfill retains the complete reasoning run.

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Only packages/fractal-ui changes plus app tests; no protocol, harness or CLI change.
